mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, c.name AS customer_name, bx.name AS box_name, z.name AS zone_name, DATE_FORMAT(i.billing_month, '%Y-%m') AS billing_month_str FROM bills b JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.id JOIN boxes bx ON c.box_id = bx.id JOIN zones z ON bx.zone_id = z.id JOIN issuances i ON b.issuance_id = i.id
mapper.select: WHERE b.issuance_id = #{issuanceId} AND b.is_trial = #{isTrial} ORDER BY c.name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bills b
AND b.issuance_id = #{issuanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bills (issuance_id, customer_id, billing_type, prev_reading, curr_reading, consumption, price_per_kwh, amper_capacity, price_per_amper, sub_fee, total_usd, total_lbp, exchange_rate, is_trial, created_at) VALUES (#{issuanceId}, #{customerId}, #{billingType}, #{prevReading}, #{currReading}, #{consumption}, #{pricePerKwh}, #{amperCapacity}, #{pricePerAmper}, #{subFee}, #{totalUsd}, #{totalLbp}, #{exchangeRate}, #{isTrial}, NOW())
